#### 1. osteocraniostenosis  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.786)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:24725)

**Proposed mechanism:** FAM111A (HGNC:34970) —LEADS_TO→ Cortical thickening of the diaphyses of long bones (HP:0005770); FAM111A (HGNC:34970) —LEADS_TO→ Short stature (HP:0004322); FAM111A (HGNC:34970) —LEADS_TO→ Cranial stenosis (HP:0001389); FAM111A (HGNC:34970) —LEADS_TO→ Osteosclerosis (HP:0004530); FAM111A (HGNC:34970) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal bone density (HP:0003157).
